scene.prompt: Full-bleed eye-level first-person POV studio photograph in 4:5 portrait aspect ratio set in a dimly lit living room bathed in deep Retail Purple (#340A5C) ambient wall light. In the foreground, a player's hands wearing silver metal-link watches enter cleanly from the bottom frame edges (y=75% to 100%), holding the exact Fantech Shooter II GP13 gaming controller drawn exactly as in the attached product sheet (matching its exact ergonomic black body, thumbstick layout, face buttons, red accent details, and crisp 'FANTECH' printed wordmark on the front, unobstructed and sharply in focus at x=30% to 70%, y=56.5% to 78%). Facing the player at mid-ground (x=16% to 84%, y=24% to 53%) is a large sleek black flat-screen television resting on a dark wood media console, displaying a warm golden-amber (#F6C96A) sunset scene of a lone adventurer walking toward a grand domed palace, flanked by softly blurred framed wall art and shelves. The upper Retail Purple (#340A5C) wall zone (x=15% to 85%, y=0% to 23%) is completely smooth, uncluttered, and dark with zero neon signs, letters, or graphics so the Kapruka logo and headline can be placed cleanly later. Shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, warm screen glow against #340A5C purple shadows and subtle cool rim light on the hands, realistic contact shadows, zero text, logos, price tags, stickers, or watermarks anywhere except the exact 'FANTECH' print on the controller.

why_it_works: Strict central vertical axis at x=50% aligns the Kapruka logo, 'GAME ON' headline, palace dome, player silhouette, and Fantech Shooter II GP13 controller for immediate visual lock.

Replacing the red wall neon with Retail Purple (#340A5C) ambient wall lighting and crisp white/yellow (#FFFFFF / #FFC107) Inter typography keeps the reference's glowing focal hierarchy while adhering to Kapruka brand rules.
Sharp foreground focus on the exact Fantech Shooter II GP13 controller paired with the warm sunset TV screen creates strong depth separation and an authentic gifting or self-purchase gaming moment.
